outcome: Relationship between asthma and other allergic diseases (eczema, allergy, rhinitis, wheeze)
cohort: 1,603 pregnant women prior to the 24th week of pregnancy at the antenatal clinic of Mobini Hospital in Iran
finding: The prevalence of asthma during pregnancy was 2.1%, and a significant relationship was found between asthma and other allergic diseases, with exposure to high levels of allergens potentially increasing the risk of pregnancy complications.
